notes.title: Arcade & Simulation
notes.content:
Untill now we have the simluation version running and you can fly around automagically multiplayer in three different worlds. You can try to harnass your flying skills with keyboard or even controller. Except for a chat there isn't much interaction though. 
So we decided that the arcade functionality had to be added to have more interaction and fun ingame. It's a reason for players to return to the game and enjoy the pursuits in the air to shoot another drone down. Trying to get a highscore and join with groups. A little bit like Red Baron.. remember?

Besides arcade the simulation will be improved to better match (FPV!) drone  physics. For starters, when you bump into something to hard, you have to start over since your props are broken.. 

Check our [url=https://trello.com/b/hWPTrhZq/fpv-drone-simulator]Trello page[/url] to check our progress for v0.75 and give a thumbs up for anything you think is most important. https://trello.com/b/hWPTrhZq/fpv-drone-simulator

notes.title: We're still alive!
notes.content:
We have picked up where we've left in januari. 
A couple months ago our soul programmer had to move his house, wife, children, computers, atari, tools, drones, 3d printer, cats, etc. to a new (ahum).. house. You know the drill. It took some time. 

We have updated the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://trello.com/b/hWPTrhZq/fpv-drone-simulator]Trello page[/url] again with our to-do's. 
Are you ready for a simulation update and an arcade choice with a real f&cking gatling gun? ;) We are.

And thank you for all the feedback through the forum and review page!

notes.title: version 0.6 update
notes.content:
Are you ready for multiplayer? 
All new games automagically start in multiplayer mode where everybody plays in the same server. More (multiplayer) functionalities will be put in future updates. 

Some of you didn't like our music choice, so now you can adjust the music volume!  :)
And we've put alot of effort into the keyboard and mouse settings. 

What's added this update?
* internet multiplayer
* multiplayer name above drone
* remapple controles for keyboard and mouse
* mouse sensitivity and smoothness
* audio settings
* forest map is updated a bit

Please vote on [url=https://trello.com/b/hWPTrhZq/fpv-drone-simulator]Trello[/url] for the features you want to be developed first in the next version!

notes.title: version 0.5 update
notes.content:
We have listenend to your wishes and updated the factory and freeride, added different drone types, so it's easier for some to fly and updated sounds/music. Happy flying and as always, check our Trello page and vote for the tasks you want to get adressed by us. https://trello.com/b/hWPTrhZq/fpv-drone-simulator

version 0.5
[list]
    [*]you can choose three different difficulties (beginner, intermediate and professional). All thee with other control pre-sets (autolevel, throttle, camera, etc)
    [*]in the factory all colliders are done. No more flying through a ceiling and such. Try flying through the hallway and doors! 
    [*]added fpv flags and gates in the factory
    [*]added some more geometrical obstacles to fly around in freeride world 
    [*]improved sound of the drone
    [*]turn upright now keeps your old orientation
    [*]added / updated logo's and icons
    [*]and many small things you might notice :)
[/list]

notes.title: Menu and new detailed world in next version 0.4
notes.content:
In the upcoming version 0.4 we've added a menu and a detailed world to fly in. The menu was a must have ofcourse. 

The detailed world is an abandoned factory. You can fly around the pillars and up the stairs towards and through the 1st floor. In the future we'll ad more to this world.. Think of flags and loops to fly through. A timer to fly a course over and over again to better your skills and time. 

Well, as always, you can use our Trello development to-do page to vote on a list to prioritize our work: https://trello.com/b/hWPTrhZq/fpv-drone-simulator
